'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Steve Skilton LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Skilton]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
